args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never exited Manufactory Nine because they are caught in a time loop that lasts slightly less than one hour [2]. When the loop ends, the hour "starts again," and anyone inside who is unable to "feel" the loop forgets the entire turn and is reset to the threshold to live it fresh [2]. Consequently, these individuals are not dead, but are instead "still walking in" every hour, a cycle that has continued for nine years [2].

The mechanism of this phenomenon is as follows:
*   **The Cause:** The Lumen Concern was digging for lumen when they struck "the Whole," causing it to "bleed" [5]. This caused space to fold and time to catch [5].
*   **The Loop:** The building collapsed during the first turn of the loop, and it has been "coming down every turn since" [5]. Because the inside of the building is a "Fold" where space is bent back on itself, the interior is larger than the exterior [4].
*   **Memory and Resetting:** Most people cannot "hold the deep Facets back," meaning they forget the turn and are reset to the top of the stairs when the hour turns [7]. Odeline Marran is able to remember every turn because she is one of the few who can "hold the deep Facets back" [7]. She has been living the same hour for nine years [6].
